ModMetadata.Name: IC10 Editor
ModMetadata.Author: aproposmath
ModMetadata.Description:
Custom IC10 editor with more features (and no lag!)
- Undo/Redo functionality (also works on accidential import) - Common keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+? for copy/paste/cut/undo/redo) - Save and close editor with Ctrl+S - Save and close editor + export to IC chip with Ctrl+E - Multiline selection - Syntax highlighting - Errors checking - Tooltips for IC10 instructions and structure hashes - Ctrl+click on a name/hash to open Stationpedia - Switch to native editor - VIM bindings (see in-game help for supported commands) - Register usage indicator - Auto completion - (optional) no line/size limit (use at your own risk, this might change or break with game updates) - no size limit for libraries
[b]Installation[/b] This is a [b]StationeersLaunchPad[/b] Plugin Mod. It requires BepInEx to be installed. See: https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad
Known issues/pitfalls: - The editor always draw on top of other windows (for instance the "Save New" input prompt when creating a new library script). Move or collapse the editor window to access these prompts.
Source Code: https://github.com/aproposmath/StationeersIC10Editor
ModMetadata.ChangeLog:
0.9.99:
Features: - Search/replace window (Ctrl+F) - Tags for version control, fix bug in diff view - Minify only works for library scripts now, minified code is shown side-by-side with original code in editor - Append '# KEEP' to a line to keep them when minifying (also keeps defines/aliases) - Error message when using a label as relative jump target - Show tooltip with value for alias/defined names - Add Commit button to library window (thx @VFox32)
Fixes: - Fix language detection (would detect Markdown instead of IC10 sometimes, thx @VFox32) - Get rid of (allmost?) all memory allocations during rendering (thx @Rocket for pointing out how bad this is :) ) - Fix inconsistent timezeone in Version History and Library Window (thx @Electrolyte) - Fix commiting all changes (thx @Electrolyte) - Fix handling BasicEnum values in define (thx @Electrolyte) - Don't allow scientific notation for numbers (to be consistent with IC10) - Fix crash with scripts containing % char in name/title (thx @TheOutride) - Keep library objects in sync between editors and library window (thx @VFox32)
